name: Therapy for Black Girls
one_liner: Free online directory for Black women and girls to find a therapist, plus the Therapy for Black Girls podcast.
best_for: Black women and girls who want to find a therapist who understands their experience
People who want free mental health information and a podcast before starting therapy
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want a service that vets therapists or provides therapy itself: listed therapists are independent
People who want a service that doesn't use advertising cookies
short_description: Free directory of therapists for Black women and girls, with a podcast and articles; you contact and pay the therapist directly.
long_description: Therapy for Black Girls, founded by psychologist Dr. Joy Harden Bradford and run by Therapy for Black Girls, LLC in Georgia, is an online resource for the mental health of Black women and girls. Its main tools are a Find a Therapist directory and the Therapy for Black Girls podcast, which is also on YouTube, Spotify and Apple Podcasts. The directory is described in its terms as an information resource for the public: the company does not employ the therapists listed, and providers are responsible for their own profile information, so you check credentials, fees and insurance with the therapist. Searching is free. The website's privacy policy says third parties may set cookies to collect information for advertising.
patient_summary: You search the free directory for a therapist and contact the one you choose directly; fees and insurance are between you and the therapist. Therapy for Black Girls does not employ or vet the therapists it lists. You can also listen to its free podcast.

pricing.notes: Directory, podcast and articles are free. Therapists listed set their own fees and insurance; you pay them directly.

privacy.notes: Policy (dated 2019) lets third parties set cookies for advertising; any user can email to delete their information. No account needed to search.

seo.title: Therapy for Black Girls: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Therapy for Black Girls is a free directory of therapists for Black women and girls in the US and Canada, with a well-known podcast and community.

faqs.q: How much does Therapy for Black Girls cost?
faqs.a: Free to search; therapists set their own fees. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Therapy for Black Girls before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Therapy for Black Girls replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: Therapy for Black Girls connects you with licensed professionals, so it can be a route into real care. It isn't an emergency service: if you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Therapy for Black Girls?
faqs.a: Therapy for Black Girls is available on the web.

faqs.q: What does Therapy for Black Girls include?
faqs.a: Directory of therapists; Filter by concern and insurance; Pro bono search option; Podcast and community.

primary_uses: Finding a therapist for Black women and girls
Articles and information on Black women's mental health
